items.title: Linear independence of standard affine A1 module monomials through affine C2 intertwining operators
items.author: Mirko Primc; Goran Trupčević
items.source_version: SIGMA21(2025),071, final form2025-08-12, published2025-08-19; publisher native TeX retrieved2026-10-13
items.difficulty_reason: The author proof addresses the mismatch between initial conditions in embedded affine A1 modules and affine C2 Feigin-Stoyanovsky subspaces. It combines an inner-derivation translation with tensor coefficients of an intertwining operator and a two-parameter induction; the complete source argument, not just the previously known basis theorem, is retained.

primary.label: Counted author assertion of linear independence, with full monomial, difference and initial conditions

proof_spans.label: Complete author translation, intertwining-operator construction and linear independence argument

contexts.label: Author affine Lie algebra and standard module setup, including native C2 root diagram
Feigin-Stoyanovsky subspaces, monomial basis and precise comparison conditions
